# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Paper study and implementation
version: "1.0"
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 2800
agents:
  - name: PaperReader
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Explain the supplied paper notes in three bullets. Identify the difference between possible membership and exact membership.
    settings: {max_iterations: 1}
  - name: DesignReviewer
    role: worker
    system_prompt: "Reply to PaperReader in two sentences. One-bit case: candidate true, exact_match false. Empty filter: candidate false, skip exact lookup. Explain why these two guarantees differ."
    settings: {max_iterations: 1}
  - name: Implementer
    model: qwen2.5-coder:3b
    model_config: {temperature: 0, max_tokens: 4096}
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Implement the design after reading both study contributions. Return exactly the two requested methods at top-level indentation in one Python fence. In confirm, use a conditional expression so a negative candidate skips the exact lookup. No prose or imports. They will be inserted into the starter class.
    settings: {max_iterations: 1}
orchestrator:
  name: Paper study
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [PaperReader, DesignReviewer, Implementer]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: paper_notes
        agent: PaperReader
        task: "Explain the paper's bit array and false positive tradeoff. /no_think"
      - name: review
        agent: DesignReviewer
        task: "Respond to paper_notes. Use size=1 explicitly. A collision must report candidate true and exact_match false. Also describe the no-lookup rule for an empty filter. /no_think"
      - name: implementation
        agent: Implementer
        task: "Use paper_notes and review to implement the two missing membership methods in one Python fence. Do not repeat the starter. /no_think"
